title: Git working tree view: dirty files in their own window (read-only)
body: Per-Project window showing uncommitted changes: staged, unstaged, untracked, colored by status, like the commit details file tree. View only, no stage/commit/push. Reuse the tree from src/git_history/details.rs and the shared git_output from l8th0t. Clicking a file should open the l8th0t diff window (HEAD/index vs working copy). Needs a short brainstorm: staged/unstaged split, refresh model (manual vs watch).
